postTitle: Gig and Informal Work: Planning Without an Employer
topic: Uneven freelance income can become a steady monthly salary

assumptions.notes: One freelance year, monthly income: Jan €1,800, Feb €4,200, Mar €900, Apr €3,600, May €2,700, Jun €5,100, Jul €1,200, Aug €3,300, Sep €2,400, Oct €4,500, Nov €600, Dec €3,900. Total €34,200. 25% set aside for tax (illustrative): €8,550. Left after tax €25,650, about €2,140 a month (25,650 ÷ 12 = 2,137.5). Fixed salary €2,000 a month, €24,000 a year. Holding account running balance lowest at €825 below zero in March; year ends €1,650 ahead (25,650 minus 24,000). Illustrative.

card.title: THE SALARY METHOD

hookVariants.narration: Your income swings from six hundred euros to five thousand one hundred. Your rent does not.
Uneven income is not a discipline problem. It is a plumbing problem, and plumbing can be fixed.
Budgeting advice starts with your monthly income. What if you do not have one?

beats.narration: One freelance year. Thirty four thousand two hundred euros in total, and no two months alike.
March brought nine hundred. November, six hundred. Budget on a good month, and these months break it.
The fix is mechanical. Every payment lands in one holding account. The day it arrives, a fixed share moves to a tax account.
Then, on the same date each month, a fixed salary moves to the everyday account. Here, two thousand euros.
Jagged income in. Two thousand euros out, every month. The holding account does the swinging.
After tax, the year left about two thousand one hundred and forty a month. So the salary held, with room to spare.
beats.subtext: A €2,000 salary, with room to spare

beats.narration: The low point came in March, when the holding account sat eight hundred and twenty five euros below zero.
beats.subtext: €825 below zero, so a buffer matters

beats.narration: One month's salary as a starting buffer covered it. The year ended one thousand six hundred and fifty euros ahead.

caption.instagram:
Your income swings from €600 to €5,100. Your rent does not.

One freelance year: €34,200 in, no two months alike. With the salary method, every payment lands in one holding account, 25% moves to a tax account the day it arrives, and a fixed €2,000 salary leaves on the same date each month. After tax the year left about €2,140 a month, so the salary held. The holding account's low point was €825 below zero in March, and the year ended €1,650 ahead. A common approach is a salary below the after tax average, reviewed after six months.

The salary method: one holding account, tax out first, a fixed salary on a fixed date, and the account absorbs the swings.
